items.html: And the reason is that the Daat of Gadlut is divided into two, namely: Hassadim and Gevurot. And the Hassadim are Havayot of MA, and the Gevurot are Havayot of BAN. But in the Daat of nursing, since it is entirely Names of Elokim, and all of them are judgments (Dinim), therefore even the Hassadim within it are aspects of the Gevurot of judgment. And there are only Gevurot there, and not Hassadim.
